name: openbb_derivatives_futures_curve
description:
Futures term structure (price by expiration month) for one commodity or financial future from Yahoo Finance through the OpenBB Platform (obb.derivatives.futures.curve).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (root symbol, e.g. CL for crude oil, GC for gold, ES for S&P 500 futures; default CL); provider (yfinance only; default yfinance, no key).
Price history of a contract: openbb_derivatives_futures_historical. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "CL", "provider": "yfinance"}

symbol.description: Futures root symbol, e.g. CL, GC, ES
